onboarding.languageHint: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Write down who lent what, let the other person confirm it, and never argue about it again.
onboarding.point1: Record a loan in a few seconds
onboarding.point2: The other person confirms with one tap, no app needed
onboarding.noMoneyMoves: {{appName}} never moves money. It only keeps a shared, friendly record.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use your phone number or email. No password needed.
auth.phoneHint: Include your country code, for example +98 or +1.

auth.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s
auth.changeContact: Use a different number or email
auth.invalidPhone: That number doesn't look right. Please include your country code.
auth.invalidEmail: That email address doesn't look right.
auth.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Please check it and try again.
auth.privacyNote: Your phone number is only ever shown to the people you share a record with.
